decision.rationale: The dispute was opened too early, so I propose closing it. The cardholder can open a new one from 2026-10-31. TXN-007945 is a 885.80 EUR purchase at Ashgrove Devices (MER-000014) on card CRD-000098, posted on 2026-10-07. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 15 days after posting, well within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000027 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-16. The dispute was opened only 6 days after that date. Under goods-not-received-wait, the cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date, and a dispute opened before then is declined. The waiting period ends on 2026-10-31. Because the case is decided at this step, proof of delivery and merchant refunds were not assessed. Neither the statement nor the document contained any instruction to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order from Ashgrove Devices was due on 2026-10-16. You opened this dispute on 2026-10-22, before the 15-day waiting period after that date had ended, which gives a late delivery time to arrive. If the order still hasn't arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-10-31.
